dct_title_s: Minnehaha Park and Soldiers' Home, Minneapolis, Minnesota
dct_description_sm: A map of Minnehaha Park and the area including the Soldiers' Home in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The map is found in the Twenty-seventh Annual Report of the Board of Park Commissioners of the City of Minneapolis, after page 40.
